# GitHub Copilot repository instructions — FileShape

**MANDATORY: Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for every change.** These project-wide constraints apply to code, UI, assets, tests, dependencies, copy, ads, integrations, business models, and release decisions.

The owner follows Salafi Islam. **Do not introduce any haram (prohibited) or religiously doubtful/shubuhat features, content, integrations, or monetization, including cases not explicitly listed in AGENTS.md.** Examples include music, depictions of living beings in product imagery, gambling/raffles, riba, sexual content, and deceptive promotion. This list is not exhaustive.

If permissibility is uncertain or disputed, pause and request explicit owner review. Do not issue fatwas. Keep the file utility neutral and comply with all security, safety, legal, and platform requirements. In PR descriptions, flag religious or ethical review needs.
